Pack: load 25.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[119,8]]]*/const D={"L_p119":"[[644,{\"name\":\"After Note: Tensei Iida\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf119\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_sports_festival\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, the Hero Killer Stain caught Tensei Iida in Hosu during the Sports Festival and cut him down; the injury to his spine took the use of his legs, and his career as Ingenium is over. He spends his days in the hospital and then in rehabilitation, in a wheelchair, and announces his retirement once he can face the press. Team Idaten carries on without him at its head. He stays warm and easy with visitors and turns the talk away from himself, but he worries about Tenya far more than about himself, and he asks after his brother's friends and studies before anything else.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf119\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[645,{\"name\":\"After Note: Ragdoll\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf120\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_kamino_incident\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Ragdoll was taken from the forest camp during the League's raid and found alive in the Nomu warehouse at Kamino, unconscious among the Nomu. She recovered in the hospital, but her Search Quirk no longer answers: she cannot register anyone, and doctors cannot say why it is gone. The Wild Wild Pussycats have suspended hero work, and she will not go back into the field without it. She keeps her bubbly manner and her cat-ear headset, laughs off sympathy and handles the team's office work and phone calls, but she still glances at new faces out of habit, reaching for a register that is no longer there.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf120\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[646,{\"name\":\"After Note: Mirio Togata\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf121\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_shie_hassaikai_raid\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Mirio Togata lost his Quirk in the Shie Hassaikai raid: he shielded Eri from a bullet built to destroy Quirks, then kept fighting Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) without Permeation until help reached them. Permeation is gone, and doctors have no way to bring it back. He has taken leave from his studies and his hero work, and he is grieving Sir Nighteye, who by canon default died of his wounds after the raid. He is still Mirio: loud, sunny, quick with a bad pun. He spends much of his time visiting Eri, keeps training out of habit, and tells anyone who looks sorry for him that he saved the person he went in to save.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf121\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[647,{\"name\":\"After Note: Bubble Girl\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf122\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_shie_hassaikai_raid\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Sir Nighteye was fatally wounded fighting Kai Chisaki (Overhaul) in the Shie Hassaikai raid and, by canon default, died in the hospital soon after, with his people around him. Bubble Girl was in the raid. She is still loud and still laughs first, because her boss insisted the agency run on humor and she means to keep that rule for him, but the laughs come shorter now, and she cries in the break room when she thinks nobody can hear. She spends her days at the agency, sorting his case files and his All Might memorabilia, and checks on Mirio Togata, who lost his Quirk in the same raid.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf122\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[648,{\"name\":\"After Note: Centipeder\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf180\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_nighteye_farewell\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Sir Nighteye's death leaves Centipeder helping the agency continue its work and supporting Bubble Girl and the interns. Let that responsibility develop through the agency rather than inventing an instant replacement mentor. If Nighteye survives, Centipeder manages ordinary work while his chief remains in medical care.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf180\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[649,{\"name\":\"After Note: Eri\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf277\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_eri_horn_and_open_gates\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Eri has entrusted her severed horn to the rescue effort and remains a protected child needing care and reassurance. Its stored energy has been spent on Izuku's recent arm injuries. She does not enter combat, and no adult treats further injury to her as a reusable supply.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf277\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[650,{\"name\":\"After Note: Endeavor #1\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf194\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_ending_natsuo\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Endeavor saw his interns rescue Natsuo when the danger to his son made him hesitate. He recognizes that atonement does not entitle him to forgiveness and decides to arrange a home where his family can live apart from him. This commitment begins practical arrangements; no unlisted residence is created or occupied automatically.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf194\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[651,{\"name\":\"After Note: Endeavor #2\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf195\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"done_war_dabi\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unless the story has established otherwise, Endeavor recognizes the son he believed dead and falters under Dabi's public accusation while Shoto fights. The broadcast exposes the stated family abuse, not every private family memory. His shock and responsibility remain unresolved; no apology or public redemption is granted by this event.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf195\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 25"];})();
